channel.title: Behold the Lamb Presents
channel.desc: The word, restoration means, the action of returning something lost, or stolen, to its former owner, place, or condition. There is no question that the dragon of Revelation 12:9, working through the Beast of Revelation 13, has stolen the seventh-day Sabbath from the Christian church over the centuries. Therefore, it was lost to the minds of the majority of God's worshippers for many years.
